name: audio-cpp
description: audio.cpp for Unraid: community-maintained installation templates using unmodified upstream Docker images and the native WebUI/audio API. Choose CPU, NVIDIA CUDA 12, NVIDIA CUDA 13, or AMD/Intel Vulkan (not yet hardware-tested) when installing. No models or personal configuration are bundled. Images follow upstream rolling Docker builds, not exclusively numbered releases. BETA: isolated runtime and private installation tests passed on one host; public branch selection and full deployment acceptance remain pending. See the README for tested images and limitations.

paths.name: Model storage
paths.description: Persistent model packages downloaded through the upstream WebUI. Must be writable by UID 99/GID 100, set through Docker --user in Extra Parameters. Existing folders may need a permissions review; PUID/PGID are not supported. No models are preselected or bundled.

ports.name: WebUI / API port
ports.description: Host HTTP port. Change this if another container uses it; leave the container port at 8080. No authentication is provided.
